# v2.1 confirmation on reserved fresh test locations (generated by scripts/report_v21.py)

- Test locations (12, never seen by any model, not part of the v2 test set): L0149, L0150, L0151, L0153, L0154, L0155, L0156, L0157, L0158, L0159, L0161, L0164
- Models: the v2 models (runs/v2), unchanged. Calibration (bias + spread) fitted on validation only (results/val/calib_choice.json); rule and this design committed before any result.
- Windows per seed: up to 100; 8 members for the replication rows, 32 for the calibration rows.

## Calibration (claim C5; rule unchanged: 90 % coverage in [0.8, 0.95] and spread-skill in [0.7, 1.3])

**Pre-registered: calibrated model (diff_phys+G+P+Cal, 32 members), combined over 3 seeds: mixed across seeds.** The validation-fitted bias correction did not transfer to the test years (it raises CRPS and MAE relative to the uncorrected 32-member ensemble).

Exploratory (seeds 1-2 added after seeing seed 0): uncorrected model with 32 members, combined over 3 seeds: supported. Compared with the 8-member rows, this indicates that most of the 8-member under-coverage comes from the small ensemble: the empirical 5-95 % interval of M members cannot reach nominal coverage for small M (even [min, max] covers (M-1)/(M+1) = 78 % for M = 8).

Replication of the other v2 claims on these locations (8 members, uncalibrated): results/v21/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md (seed-robustness table).

Caveat: only the locations downloaded by the deadline were used; bootstrap intervals over so few location clusters are wide, so this is a small confirmation, not a replacement for the main test.
